items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You met Don Brooks, a white alto player in the city.

ctx.x: But it’s a rundown on the way I was. At that time...

There’s also information here about Memphis. I’ll read it into the record. These are your words, so we’ll let it speak for itself. Once returned to Ole Miss, you took weekend trips to Memphis. In ‘47 and ‘48, you went to various clubs. You met Phineas Newborn, Jr. You met Don Brooks, a white alto player in the city. And you met B.B. King’s bass player, Shenny Walker.
Yeah, Shenny Walker. I was trying to think of him. I used to go around to his house to jam sessions.
